title: BACK TO BASICS: REVISITING ASR IN THE AGE OF VOICE AGENTS

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) performance (Word Error Rate and Character Error Rate) on sub-corpora featuring speech from children and older adults to assess performance degradation compared to standard working-age adult speech.
Evaluating ASR error rates on datasets containing diverse non-native English accents and regional Chinese dialects to identify performance disparities against standard accents.
Comparing ASR performance, hallucination rates, and prompt sensitivity across four different languages (English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean) to identify disparities in multilingual model robustness.
